definitions.title: Scalar Surface Integral
definitions.latex: \iint_S g(x, y, z) \, d\sigma = \iint_R g(x(u, v), y(u, v), z(u, v)) |\mathbf{r}_u \times \mathbf{r}_v| \, du \, dv
definitions.statement: The surface integral of a continuous scalar function g over smooth surface S accumulates g weighted by area element d sigma. Computes mass of thin shell S when g is surface density.
conditions: g is continuous on smooth surface S
definitions.explanation: Generalizes line integrals from 1D curves to 2D curved surfaces in space.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Integrates scalar distributions across curved surfaces.

definitions.title: Flux of a Vector Field (Surface Integral of Vector Field)
definitions.statement: The flux of vector field F through oriented surface S measures the net volume of fluid flowing across S per unit time in the direction of unit normal n.
conditions: S is an orientable surface with chosen continuous unit normal n
definitions.explanation: For graph z = f(x, y) with upward normal, F . n d sigma = (-M f_x - N f_y + P) dx dy.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Fundamental in electromagnetism (Gauss's Law) and fluid dynamics.
